While the Blue Box manga officially ended on July 13 , we can still follow our favorite characters in the anime adaptation currently airing. Blue Box Season 2 explores new sides of the cast and introduces the long awaited Yumeka Goto, a person from Chinatsu’s past. That’s why we were excited to interview Season 2 director Daisuke Sako about Yumeka, the themes explored during the season, and his takes on the story’s message. © Kouji Miura/SHUEISHA, Blue Box Film Partners. items.summary: Events Press Conference Bartosz Sztybor and Saya Elder on Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2’s Emotional Impact Written by Jorge Manuel Sanchez Moreno Cardenas November 11, 2026 CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 2 left no one indifferent after the worldwide release of the ten-episode season on October 20. The latest installment is a new story in the noir world of Night City after the events of Season 1, with a whole new set of characters and ideas on the table brought to life again by Studio TRIGGER and CD PROJEKT RED (CDPR). Following the premiere, Season 2’s showrunner Bartosz Sztybor and executive producer Saya Elder from CDPR flew to the Italian festival Lucca Comics & Games and took part in a special panel on the third day of the convention, October 30, in Cinema Astra. Under the name “Emotional Damage: How Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Makes You Feel,” both guests spoke with journalist Eva Carducci about the decisions behind the new season, and the emotions they put into the show. Portions of this panel have been edited for clarity. Beware of CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 1 and 2 plot spoilers below. Q: How do you make people emotional? Bartosz: Honestly I don’t know. It just happens. What needs to be done is that the creators need to be sincere with themselves. That’s why I always put myself into the characters that I’m creating. It’s also important that when I write stories, they are always character driven. The plot is important, of course. But the character is the most important thing in the plot. items.title: Exclusive Preview: Ram V Launches Mirror Maker Studios Ahead of Deicidium Volume 1 Release
items.summary: News Exclusive Preview: Ram V Launches Mirror Maker Studios Ahead of Deicidium Volume 1 Release Written by Anime Corner November 11, 2026 Eisner Award-winning writer Ram V has launched Mirror Maker Studios, a new creative studio and ideas incubator built around projects developed by Ram V and his collaborators. The launch is accompanied by a new Mirror Maker YouTube channel focused on the creative process behind comics, writing, animation, games, and other narrative work. The channel will feature creator discussions, process-focused videos, and behind-the-scenes material from ongoing projects. Mirror Maker also plans to begin publishing episodic narrative fiction through the channel in 2027. Ram V commented: “I believe that the ability to create things and make art is one of humanity’s most beautiful aspects; worth valuing and encouraging,” said Ram V. “At a time when companies seem to want to push both creators and consumers to accept mass produced content devoid of human perspective and endeavour, I think more creators should convey the magic that exists in the process of making things, not merely in the product.
